[TODO:ar] Flee with what little remains

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Laugh and dismiss the angel
[TODO:ar] Insist you are too weak
[TODO:ar] Bow and accept His calling

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Bow and accept His calling

weak_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] He chose you because you are small.
Let Him be strong through you.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Bow and accept His calling

fleece_test.text:
[TODO:ar] Doubt still gnaws at your heart.
You lay the wool on the ground.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Ask humbly for His confirmation

[TODO:ar] Ignore your doubts and march

ignore_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] He answers honest questions.
Lay your fear before Him.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Ask humbly for His confirmation
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] His sign comes with the morning.

army_reduction.title: [TODO:ar] The Spring of Harod
army_reduction.text:
[TODO:ar] "Your army is too many," He says.
Thirty-two thousand wait behind you.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Refuse — you need every man
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] His count is not your count.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Send home the fearful and watchful
[TODO:ar] Hide some in the hills as backup

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] He Saves By Few
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] If you keep the many, you steal His glory.
Obey and trim the ranks.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Send home the fearful and watchful
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The camp grows still and small.

hide_consequence.text:

Hidden men reveal hidden fear.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Send home the fearful and watchful

night_attack.text:
[TODO:ar] The Midianite camp sprawls below.
Torches in jars, trumpets in hand.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Charge the camp in silent steel
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] His way is not the sword first.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Wait for daylight and reinforcements
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Now is the hour He gave.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Break the jars and sound the trumpets
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Light and sound flood the valley.

charge_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] His Plan, His Victory
charge_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Steel alone will not break them.
Obey the strange command.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Break the jars and sound the trumpets
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You raise the clay jar high.

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] The Hour Is Now
wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] He has shaken them in their dreams.
Do not waste the night He gave.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Break the jars and sound the trumpets

victory.title: [TODO:ar] The Sword of the Lord
victory.text:
[TODO:ar] Midian turns sword on Midian.
The vast camp scatters into the dark.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Give the glory to the Lord alone
[TODO:ar] Boast of your clever battle plan
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] His arm broke them, not yours.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Demand a crown from the people
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The Lord shall rule over you.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] Lift His Name
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] Three hundred could never have done this.
Give Him every word of praise.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Give the glory to the Lord alone
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You bow as the camp burns.

crown_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] He Is the King
crown_consequence.text:
[TODO:ar] No throne belongs in your hand.
Return the glory to its Owner.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Give the glory to the Lord alone
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You lay the crown back down.

ending_faithful.title: [TODO:ar] The Land Has Peace
ending_faithful.text:
[TODO:ar] Forty years of quiet will follow.
Fear became faith, weakness His power.
